title: Zoom Releases FY 2026 Impact Report
summary: Read more about: Zoom Releases FY 2026 Impact Report
body_markdown:
As Zoom Communications, Inc. (NASDAQ: ZM) celebrates 15 years of caring for customers, we are pleased to announce the release of our FY26 Impact Report, highlighting the company’s achievements across environmental impact, social impact, and governance practices.


As the AI-first work platform for human connection, Zoom continues to innovate with new AI product releases, strategic acquisitions, and secure privacy practices. As the business evolves, Zoom continues to drive impact across environmental operations, charitable giving, and responsible governance practices.


**Key Highlights:**


- Positive Environmental Impact: Launched the Zoom Forest initiative, planting nearly 19,000 coastal mangroves in Brazil—one tree for every Zoom Store purchase.
- Advanced Regulatory Preparation: Completed Zoom’s first-ever climate risk and double materiality assessments.
- AI for Good:[Committed $10M](https://www.zoom.com/en/zoom-cares/commitment-to-ai-for-good/) to support students, educators, nonprofits, and workers to thrive in an AI-driven world through cash and product grants.
- Five Years of Zoom Cares: Distributed over $70M in cash grants, product donations, and employee-led giving to communities worldwide since the program’s inception.
- Strategic Acquisitions: Welcomed[Bonsai](https://www.zoom.com/en/blog/zoom-acquires-bonsai/) and[Brighthire](https://www.zoom.com/en/blog/zoom-acquires-brighthire/) to expand Zoom’s AI-first work platform.
- Security and Privacy Successes: Continue to maintain dozens of attestations and certifications, demonstrating Zoom’s commitment to keeping customer data safe and secure.


Explore the FY26 Impact Report which details Zoom’s product innovations, sustainability efforts, and social impact initiatives, visit[zoom.com/trust/impact](https://www.zoom.com/en/about/esg-impact-report/) .


**About Zoom**


Zoom (NASDAQ: ZM) is a system of action for modern work, turning live collaboration into completed results. From entrepreneurs to global enterprises, customers choose Zoom to seamlessly collaborate, communicate, and drive outcomes across meetings, phone, contact center, and more — all with the built-in assistance of Zoom AI. Founded in 2011, Zoom is headquartered in San Jose, CA. For more information, visit[zoom.com](http://zoom.com/) .
